scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; verify.py checks only finite exact-rational instances. General Doob-transform and constant-killing mechanisms are acknowledged as known. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected graphs with positive rates in both orientations of every edge; 2<=k<=n-1 labeled particles. No statement for infinite graphs, one-way networks, or non-Markov holding times. Cyclic maximal-density examples overlap known ring specializations. Possible older Q-process or weighted token-graph equivalents remain to be checked independently.
title: A sharp one-vacancy exception for noncollision conditioning on weighted graphs
